source.title: Catalogue of unfiltered x-ray spectra from tungsten-, molybdenum-, and rhodium-anode-based x-ray tubes with generating voltages from 10kV to 50kV in steps of 1kV
source.citation: Ketelhut, S., & Büermann, L. (2020). Catalogue of unfiltered x-ray spectra... [Data set]. Physikalisch-Technische Bundesanstalt. https://doi.org/10.7795/720.20201118

basis_conditions.unknown_ripple_note: Data-file headers do not specify ripple; no value is inferred.
basis_conditions.note_zh: PTB 实測基谱已经包含 1 mm Be 窗和 100 cm 空气路径，不是裸靶谱；无需再次施加这两项。

grid.evaluation_energy_coordinate: bin center (source upper edge minus 0.125 keV)
grid.weights: per-bin photon fluence, normalized to unit total for each basis voltage
grid.spectral_density_conversion: source Phi_per_keV × 0.25 keV, then normalized after endpoint cutoff

processing.endpoint_rule: retain source bins whose upper edge is <= tube voltage (keV); remove above-endpoint measurement tails
processing.normalization: normalize each truncated basis spectrum to unit total photon fluence
processing.interpolation: linear in kVp between neighboring normalized basis weights on the same grid; truncate energies >= requested kVp and renormalize
processing.limitation_zh: 中间电压的谱是参考谱插值，尚无额外实测核验；不能据此宣称标准验收合格。

attenuation_sources.Al_Air: Exact unchanged Al/Air tables copied from the supplied ISO Python reference; the numeric kernel uses identical log-log interpolation and right-hand value at duplicate absorption-edge energies.

limitations_zh: 光子谱来自特定 PTB 钼靶装置的测量，经过数学过滤形成模型估计谱，不是 IEC/IAEA 唯一指定的谱。
基谱在每个电压分别归一化，结果不表示绝对空气比释动能率，不能跨电压比较绝对输出。
HVL 与标准表值的残差单独显示；JS 与 Python 一致性不等于对实际装置的测量准确度。
